name: image-tab1
blurb: Image tabs with large preview showing on active tab.
description: Tab layout with image preview panel. TabsProvider + TabList + TabItem + TabHeader + TabDes + TabImageContainer + TabImage. Animated transitions.
use_when: Portfolio, product showcase, or case study layouts where images drive engagement.
avoid_when: Text-heavy content; image tabs add vertical scroll.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable. Image descriptions (TabDes) provide context. Images have alt text.
